# Budget

> A local-first budget app served as a static SPA at
> budget.niclaslindstedt.se. The user's ledger lives in their browser's
> localStorage and, optionally, in their own Dropbox app folder. There
> is no backend, no account on a server, and no analytics SDK.

## For agents

The single highest-value URL on this site for an AI agent is the data
schema. When a user hands you a `budget-YYYY-MM-DD.json` export, fetch
the schema and validate against it — every field, every enum, every
constraint, and a prose description of what each piece means is on
that one page, both as a `<pre>` code block and as a
`<script type="application/schema+json">` element you can extract
without scraping.

- [Data schema](https://budget.niclaslindstedt.se/schema/): JSON Schema
  (Draft 2020-12) for the `budget-*.json` files Budget exports.
  Includes the column-id-keyed-cells gotcha, the derived `balance`
  column, category-cells-hold-ids-not-names, and `seriesId` semantics.

## Pages

- [Home](https://budget.niclaslindstedt.se/): the app itself. SPA;
  requires JavaScript.
- [Privacy policy](https://budget.niclaslindstedt.se/privacy/): how
  Budget handles your data. Local-first, no backend, no analytics.
- [Data schema](https://budget.niclaslindstedt.se/schema/): the JSON
  Schema reference for exported budget files.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/budget):
  source, issues, releases. MIT-licensed.
